title: Setting up a fixture once
target: How to configure the fixtures in a TCG Card Shop Simulator shop at the fixture itself, using the setting screens the game gives each one.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Money for whatever you are changing

steps.do: Stand at the fixture you are changing rather than hunting for one menu for all of them.
steps.because: there are setting screens per kind of fixture (SetCashierCounterSettingScreen)

steps.do: Price items at their own screen before you rely on them selling.
steps.because: there is a screen for setting an item price (SetItemPriceScreen)

steps.do: Number your play tables so you can tell one from another.
steps.because: tables are numbered through their own screen (SetPlayerTableNumberScreen)

steps.do: Set card storage shelves at the shelf rather than from memory.
steps.because: storage shelves have a setting screen of their own (SetCardStorageShelfSettingScreen)

steps.do: Read the confirmation before selling a shelf.
steps.because: selling a shelf has a confirm screen of its own (ConfirmSellShelfScreen)

commonMistakes: Looking for a single global settings menu for fixtures.
Filling a shelf that was never configured.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
